messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired -> GPU_ALLOC_FAILURE (pool: us-west-2a). Severity: P1. AlertID: PD-67291. Autosuppress: no. Link: https://pd.company/pd/alerts/PD-67291 :rotating_light:
oncall-maya: Acked and taking. Joining now.
oncall-maya: Seeing KV cache reclaim spikes on the dashboard, multiple alloc fails in the last 30s.
sre-jordan: I'm on it, pulling nvml logs and docker ps from the pod.
infra-aaron: Noted - I can spin a warm fallback pool in us-west-2b, want me to start that?
oncall-maya: Yes please, +1 to fallback. Also patch traffic routing to avoid affected nodes.
pagerduty-bot: PD note: escalation to SRE lead if not acked in 5m.
sre-jordan: Logs (filtered):
```
GPU_ALLOC failed: out of memory
pid=4211 tid=2345 nvmlError=NVML_ERROR_UNKNOWN
kvcache: evicted 128MB in 2s
```

support-rachel: Any customer-facing impact? Support page shows 3 customer requests flagged with timeouts.
oncall-maya: Quick check: 3 customers with increased 5xx rate around 2023-11-14T01:12:00Z. ETA to mitigate depends on reroute.
sre-jordan: Trying quick remediation: clearing local kvcache on affected servers, restart of inference-worker on node gpu-uw2a-17.
infra-aaron: Fallback pool creation started: gpu-fallback-usw2b-01..04 provisioning. ETA ~90s.
sre-jordan: Rolling restart command I ran: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/infer-worker -n inference --field-selector=spec.nodeName=gpu-uw2a-17`
oncall-maya: Good. Watch for OOMs reappearing after restart.
sre-jordan: Restart complete on gpu-uw2a-17. Observability: alloc-fail rate halved but still present. Some jobs moving to fallback pool.
sre-jordan: Applied temporary autoshedder patch (lower max-batch-size from 64 -> 32) to reduce memory footprint. Patch diff: 
```
- max_batch_size: 64
+ max_batch_size: 32
```

infra-aaron: Fallback nodes are healthy and accepting traffic. Rerouting now via router-cli: `router update-route --pool infer-usw2a -> infer-usw2b-fallback`
support-rachel: Notified affected customers 1234/5678 with note: "We detected elevated GPU allocation errors; traffic rerouted to fallback capacity. Minimal impact expected."
oncall-maya: Handing off to Jordan for stabilization and postmortem. I'm stepping off.
sre-jordan: Taking over. Next steps: collect heap dumps from the three noisy workers, capture nvml traces, and keep the autoshedder change as a temporary mitigator.
sre-jordan: Current customer impact: 3 customers saw 502/504 spikes for ~2-6 minutes, some inference latency increased by ~400-900ms. No data exfiltration.
pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by oncall-maya, escalation canceled.
infra-aaron: I'll keep fallback pool at +20% headroom for 2 hours, then scale down if stable.
sre-jordan: Creating incident ticket IN-20231114-67291 and attaching traces.
support-rachel: I'll follow up with customers after postmortem, asking if they observed anomalies beyond errors.
oncall-maya: Thanks everyone. If anything resurfaces ping @sre-jordan directly. :thumbsup:
sre-jordan: Will open runbook checklist items: `collect nvml logs`, `kvcache metrics dump`, `compare model memory growth` and `postmortem draft`.
incident-bot: Incident closed by oncall-maya at 1777777045 (auto-note: mitigations in place).
